You win some, you lose some

Better late than never, but never late is better

The best way out is always through

The code is more what you’d call ‘guidelines’ than actual rules.
Time is what we want most, but what we use worst.

There was always a way, when one knew what one wanted
Do or do not, there is no try
Being unique is better than being perfect
It always seems impossible until it's done
With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts
Problems are not stop signs, they are guidelines.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started
A goal is a dream with a deadline
If you don't like how things are, change it! You're not a tree.
It is never too late to be what you might have been.
We must let go of the life we have planned, so as to accept the one that is waiting for us
We know what we are, but know not what we may be
Without craftsmanship, inspiration is a mere reed shaken in the wind.
If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door
No act of kindness, no matter how small, is ever wasted.
The power of imagination makes us infinite
Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud
Give light, and the darkness will disappear of itself
The measure of who we are is what we do with what we have.
Noble deeds that are concealed are most esteemed
From a small seed a mighty trunk may grow
We have it in our power to begin the world over again.
Nothing is worth more than this day.
The one where we fix some issues
To the mind that is still, the whole universe surrenders.
We are here to make another world
Let each person exercise the art they know
It is always the simple that produces the marvelous
Each day provides its own gifts
I love those who yearn for the impossible

Fixed usage of deprecated mysql_native_password plugin (#2101)

closes https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost/issues/26912

The mysql_native_password auth plugin is disabled by default in MySQL
8.4 and removed in MySQL 9.0. By omitting the IDENTIFIED WITH clause,
the server uses its default auth plugin (caching_sha2_password on 8.0+),
which mysql2 supports natively. This adds a new CI job that runs the full
install flow against a MySQL 8.4 Docker container to repro the failure.

🐛 Fixed nginx failing to start when ap.ghost.org is unresolvable (#2274)

closes https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost-CLI/issues/2044

nginx resolves hostnames in literal `proxy_pass` directives when it loads its
config, so a momentary DNS outage - a reboot, or systemd-resolved restarting
during an unattended upgrade - made the whole site fail to start with
`host not found in upstream "ap.ghost.org"`.

The ActivityPub locations now assign the upstream to a variable and declare a
`resolver`, which defers the lookup to request time. A DNS outage now only
affects the ActivityPub routes, and nginx starts either way.

The resolver addresses are read from /etc/resolv.conf at setup time (nginx OSS
can't read it itself), so split-horizon and internal DNS keep working; public
resolvers are only used if resolv.conf lists none.

Existing installs are updated by a migration, which rewrites the ActivityPub
locations in place, runs `nginx -t`, and restores the original config if the
result doesn't validate.

Combined the test workflows into a single CI workflow (#2302)

* Combined the test workflows into a single CI workflow

Branch protection needs one required check per workflow job, which meant
tracking every unit / e2e / local-e2e job name separately and updating the
settings whenever a matrix leg changed. Merging them into one workflow lets
a single "All required tests passed or skipped" job gate the branch, the
same pattern Ghost's own ci.yml uses.

Job steps are unchanged apart from two side effects of the merge: unit tests
now share the workflow's cancel-in-progress concurrency group, and the unit
matrix gets fail-fast: false to match the other jobs.

* Stopped persisting git credentials in CI checkouts

actions/checkout writes the job's GITHUB_TOKEN into .git/config by default,
so it stays on disk for the rest of the job. The e2e jobs make this worse by
copying the whole checkout to /opt/cli, which duplicates the token into a
world-readable path before running Ghost. Nothing in CI uses git after the
checkout, and no dependency resolves over git, so the token is dead weight.

Also binds toJson(needs) to an env var rather than interpolating it into the
gate job's shell script, so job outputs can never be evaluated as shell.

🎨 Improved import/export HTTP error messages (#2303)

ref https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost-CLI/issues/2284

Ghost's API returns errors as `{errors: [{message, context, code}]}`, but the
CLI threw the body away and surfaced ky's generic "Request failed with status
code 500" instead - with no indication of which request had failed.

- added a shared ky client with a `beforeError` hook that rewrites the message
  to `METHOD /path failed (status): <ghost message> <context>`, and stashes the
  Ghost error code on the error (the hook consumes the response body, so callers
  can't read it themselves)
- this covers every import/export request, including the `db/` import & export
  calls that previously had no error handling at all
- 2FA failures now point at Staff access tokens, since there's no way to enter a
  verification code from the CLI

🎨 Resolved open CodeQL scanning alerts (#2304)

- `randomUsername` now uses `crypto.randomInt` instead of `Math.random`, which
  CodeQL flags as insecure randomness feeding MySQL user creation. The username
  isn't a secret (the password is already crypto-random), but the switch is free
  and spreads better across the 1000-value space.
- `ui.sudo` shell-quotes the node/ghost binary paths it splices in from
  `process.argv`. Previously an install path containing a space broke every
  `sudo ghost ...` call, since the command runs through a shell. The replacement
  is also done via a function so `$&`/`$1` sequences in a path aren't treated as
  regex replacement patterns.
- The stale workflow declares explicit `issues: write` / `pull-requests: write`
  permissions rather than inheriting the repo-default token scope.

The remaining alert on `ui.sudo` ("shell command constructed from library
input") was dismissed as won't fix: `sudo()` is a shell-command runner by
design, with ~40 internal callers passing constructed command strings, and
Ghost-CLI isn't consumed as a library.

Added a clear error when pnpm is too old for Ghost's pinned pnpm (#2336)

refs #2335

Ghost 6.62.0 is the first release to pin pnpm 12 in its `packageManager`
field. pnpm 12 ships as a native binary that its npm package unpacks in an
install script, and pnpm older than 11.10.0 provisions the pinned version
without running that script - leaving the package's placeholder text file
in place of the binary. `ghost update` then ran the placeholder and failed
with `Syntax error: ")" unexpected`, which gives no hint at what to do.

- the doctor check now fails before Ghost is downloaded when the installed
  pnpm is older than 11.10.0 and the target Ghost version pins pnpm 12
- if the placeholder is reached anyway (e.g. it was left behind by an
  earlier run), the shell parse error is translated into a system error
  that names the cause and the fix

Corepack is unaffected - it downloads pnpm 12's platform binary directly -
so the corepack fallback is left alone.
